salary_basis: Typical gross monthly pay in Nigeria, from entry level to experienced, including bonuses (Paylab Nigeria salary survey). Indicative only.
cgpa_note: cgpa.min is the level many employers ask for (for example a 2:1 = 3.50 for bank and Big Four graduate programmes); cgpa.ideal makes a graduate competitive for the most selective roles. null means the role is licensed by professional exams, not CGPA.
